title: 第3509章 不可能顺利第3508章 来来来给你吞噬
content_zh:
，，！
不可能顺利！
（不可能顺利！
（第22页）正常情况下，也只有高位仙君为了提升修为，才会一口气吞下好几枚仙君丹！
倘若是普通的八步仙王，一口气吞下好几枚仙君丹，早就爆体而亡了！
苏无敌冷哼一声，转头看向那些正在积蓄力量，正准备对那道防御结界联手发出第五次轰击的光辉至尊等人……“哼！”
“不就是几枚仙君丹吗？小爷我一口气吞服几十枚仙君丹给你看一看！”
只见他话音落下，忽然撤回了所有的过去真身。
然后取出几十枚仙君丹，一口气吞了下去。
光寿仙君双眼一眯，当即停止了攻击，冷眼看着苏无敌，等着他爆体而亡。
轰隆隆！
轰隆隆隆！
苏无敌体内，狂暴的药力剧烈翻涌，犹如几十座火山在他体内同时爆发！
喀嚓！
喀嚓！
喀嚓！
他的肉身，当即出现一道道恐怖裂痕，鲜血喷涌，血肉剥落！
就连他的修炼核心，都出现了一道道细微裂痕！
就和苏毅、苏珂一样，他最近的修为，提升的也很迅速！
并且半个月内，刚刚强行提升了一个小境界！

倘若他早已境界稳固……就算一口气提升两三个小境界，也没有太大问题！
但是在此之前，他已经接连提升了两三个小境界了，如今再强行提升，后果就严重了！
“吼啊——”
苏无敌忽然发出一声嘶吼！
他的周身气息，骤然暴涨了一大截，从七步仙王之境成功晋升到八步仙王之境！
然而。
他身上的气息，依旧还在继续攀升！
这一刻，他的耳鼻口眼当中，都在喷涌鲜血！
身上的血肉，犹如冰雪融化一般，剥落的更加迅速了，触目惊心，令人不忍直视。
光寿仙君冷哼一声，立马率领所剩无几的第二真身和身外化身，朝着苏毅苏珂那边的战场赶了过去。
在他看来，苏无敌必死无疑，已经无需理会！
一口气吞服了几十枚仙君丹，就算是一位高位仙君，也有可能爆体而亡！
更何况他一尊小小的七步仙王？“吼啊——”
“给我突破！”
就在这时，苏无敌再次发出一声嘶吼！
他的修为，再次提升，从八步仙王之境提升到了九步仙王之境！
和苏毅、苏珂，乃至苏尘一样，成为了一尊九步仙王！
要知道，苏无敌的天资，远超苏毅苏珂，甚至不比苏尘逊色多少啊！
不过此刻的苏无敌，浑身血肉，几乎已经完全剥落！
就连一身仙骨，也布满了裂痕！

他那一枚枚修炼核心之上，自然也布满了一道道细微裂痕！
他立马取出几十枚道基丹吞服下去……虽然这些道基丹，无法完全抹去掉对他未来的影响……但却瞬间修复了他此刻的道基之创！
content_en:
,,!
It can't go smoothly!
(It can’t go smoothly!
(Page 22) Under normal circumstances, only high-ranking Immortal Lords would swallow several Immortal Lord Pills in one go in order to improve their cultivation!
If it were an ordinary Eight-Step Immortal King who swallowed several Immortal Lord Pills in one breath, he would have exploded and died!
Su Wudi snorted coldly and turned to look at the Glory Supreme and others who were gathering strength and preparing to jointly launch a fifth bombardment on the defensive barrier... "Hmph!"
"Isn't it just a few Immortal Lord Pills? I'll swallow dozens of Immortal Lord Pills in one breath to show you!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he suddenly withdrew all his past identities.
Then he took out dozens of Immortal Lord Pills and swallowed them in one breath.
Immortal Lord Guangshou narrowed his eyes and immediately stopped attacking. He looked at Su Wudi coldly, waiting for him to explode and die.
Boom!
Rumble, rumble!
Within Su Wudi's body, the violent medicinal power surged violently, like dozens of volcanoes erupting in his body at the same time!
Click!
Click!
Click!
Terrifying cracks immediately appeared in his body, blood spurted out, and flesh and blood peeled off!
Even his cultivation core had tiny cracks!
Just like Su Yi and Su Ke, his recent cultivation has improved very quickly!
And within half a month, I just forcibly improved to a small level!
If he has already stabilized his realm...even if he can improve two or three small realms in one breath, there won't be a big problem!
But before that, he had already improved to two or three small realms in succession. Now if he tries to improve again, the consequences will be serious!
"Roar——"
Su Wudi suddenly let out a roar!
The aura around him suddenly increased significantly, and he was successfully promoted from the realm of the Seven-Step Immortal King to the realm of the Eight-Step Immortal King!
However.
The aura on his body is still continuing to rise!
At this moment, blood was gushing out from his ears, nose, mouth, and eyes!
The flesh and blood on his body peeled off faster like ice and snow, which was shocking and unbearable to look at.
Immortal Lord Guangshou snorted coldly, and immediately led the few remaining second true bodies and external incarnations towards the battlefield on Su Yi and Su Ke's side.
In his opinion, Su Wudi was bound to die, so there was no need to worry about it!
After swallowing dozens of Immortal Lord Pills in one breath, even a high-ranking Immortal Lord may explode and die!
What's more, he is a small seven-step immortal king? "Roar——"
"Give me a breakthrough!"
At this moment, Su Wudi roared again!
His cultivation has improved again, from the realm of the Eight-step Immortal King to the realm of the Nine-step Immortal King!
Like Su Yi, Su Ke, and even Su Chen, he became a nine-step immortal king!
You know, Su Wudi's talent far exceeds that of Su Yi and Su Ke, and is not even inferior to Su Chen!
But at this moment, Su Wudi's flesh and blood had almost completely peeled off!
Even the immortal bones are full of cracks!
His cultivation cores are naturally covered with tiny cracks!
He immediately took out dozens of Daoji pills and swallowed them... Although these Daoji pills could not completely erase the impact on his future... they instantly repaired his current Daoji creation!
